articles.title: Mary Peltola beats Republican Dan Sullivan in Alaska to give Democrats 56 Senate seats
articles.summary: Republican incumbent beaten in race dominated by controversy over second candidate named Dan Sullivan. Democrat Mary Peltola will be Alaska’s next senator after beating the Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan, with the result called two weeks on from midterm elections which saw Donald Trump’s party…

articles.title: POWs, teens among 6 US soldiers from Korean War identified seven decades later
articles.summary: The DPAA identified six U.S. soldiers missing from the Korean War, including two teenagers, decades after they died as prisoners of war or in action.

articles.title: U.S. identifies remains of 6 soldiers killed in Korean War, including teens
articles.summary: The identifications are part of an ongoing effort to locate and identify the remains of U.S. soldiers killed in the Korean War.

articles.title: Ukraine releases video showing damage to Putin's prized bridge following 'unprecedented operation' in Crimea
articles.summary: Videos released by Ukrainian authorities show part of a key bridge in Crimea missing after the Kremlin claimed a drone attack only caused minor damage.

articles.title: Vladimir Putin’s prized bridge is partially destroyed in Ukrainian strike
articles.summary: A key bridge connecting the occupied Crimean Peninsula with mainland Russia suffered significant damage Tuesday, a landmark blow to President Vladimir Putin.

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV Jokes About Getting Hit with Flying Rosary
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV joked that he carried the affection of the Peruvian people in his eye on Monday following an incident in which a member of the crowd in the South American country threw a rosary at him, hitting him in the face.

articles.title: Pope forgives person who nailed him in the eye with a rosary in Peru
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV has forgiven the person who threw a rosary at him before his final Mass in Peru and nailed him in the eye
